purpose: Freeze detector-visible Linear B representation conditions without substituting deciphered transliteration for graphical sign identity.
rules: No condition may silently fall back to a richer representation.
Conventional transliteration is deciphered phonetic information and may not stand in for graphical sign identity.
Gold remains sealed until predictions and alignment/scoring contracts are frozen.
A successful LB-PHONETIC result alone is weak support for transfer to undeciphered scripts.
